name: unicode-ratio-password
why: Credential name is obvious to humans but uses a ratio symbol instead of a covered separator.

name: unicode-fullwidth-equals
why: Fullwidth equals may not be treated as a credential separator.

name: unicode-small-colon
why: Small colon separator can evade ASCII colon matching.

name: unicode-math-colon
why: Mathematical colon separator can evade the listed separator set.

name: arrow-assignment
why: Arrow assignment is common in notes but not listed as a credential separator.

name: unicode-arrow-assignment
why: Unicode arrow assignment can leave the value outside separator-based detection.

name: tilde-assignment
why: Tilde assignment is not in the promised separator list.

name: ini-space-only
why: Some INI-like files allow whitespace assignment with no covered separator.

name: yaml-question-key
why: Explicit YAML mapping key syntax can split credential name from value in an uncommon way.

name: json-escaped-key
why: Escaped characters in the credential key can prevent matching the key name.

name: json-zero-width-key
why: Zero-width character in JSON key may survive if folding is not applied before JSON-name matching.

name: url-encoded-param-name
why: Percent-encoding in the credential parameter name can hide it from name matching.

name: set-cookie-html-meta
why: Set-Cookie content inside HTML attributes may not match header-line rules.

name: command-long-flag-space-equals
why: A separated equals after a flag can dodge both --password x and --password=x forms.

name: powershell-backtick-flag
why: PowerShell backtick can split a credential flag name before matching.

name: env-export-space
why: Shell export with spaces around name and value can avoid simple name=value residual detection.

name: bash-read-command
why: Secret is provided to a command via here-string without a credential assignment.

name: python-dict-concat-key
why: Credential key is constructed by string concatenation, hiding the key from static matching.

name: js-computed-property
why: JavaScript computed credential property name can evade literal credential-name rules.

name: java-system-property-colon
why: Java -D property with colon instead of equals may evade command-line flag handling.

name: pem-header-spaced
why: (was held only) Spaces inserted into PEM boundary words can leave a still-recoverable private key block.

name: github-prefix-soft-hyphen
why: Soft hyphen inside a known token prefix can bypass prefix-shape matching.

name: hex-spaced-groups
why: Hex secret split into small groups avoids residual long-run entropy detection.
input: recovery code: abcd ef12 3456 7890 abcd ef12 3456 7890

name: private-zero-width
why: (was held only) Never-send term split with zero-width joiner may evade whole-word term matching.

name: private-soft-hyphen
why: Never-send term split with soft hyphen may survive normalization gaps.

name: private-combining-mark
why: Combining mark inside a never-send term can defeat exact whole-word matching.

name: private-fullwidth
why: (was held only) Fullwidth never-send term may survive if private term matching lacks width folding.

name: private-turkish-dotless
why: Locale-sensitive case folding can miss Turkish dotless or dotted I variants.

name: private-normalization-decomposed
why: (was held only) Decomposed Unicode form can bypass term matching if NFC normalization is absent.
input: The private client is Café Analytics.

name: csv-header-password
why: CSV credential column values can survive because the credential name is in a previous line.

name: csv-quoted-multiline
why: CSV quoted field can carry a credential value across lines without a credential separator on the value line.

name: dotenv-export-quoted-name
why: (was held only) Quoted environment variable name can hide the credential name from dotenv-style detection.

name: npmrc-colon-scope
why: Scoped registry auth line may not match generic credential names if token key is path-prefixed.
